000.evidence: Both blue eyes and chin lift above the neutral facial aim; the head stays frontal.

022.5.evidence: Eyes lift and shift to screen-right; rightward cheek and hair contour starts to lead.

045.evidence: Face turns three-quarter screen-right while pupils and chin remain raised.

067.5.evidence: Nose and visible eye aim screen-right and above the head center; far cheek recedes.

090.evidence: Unmistakable screen-right profile with nose at the right edge of the head and far eye occluded.

112.5.evidence: Head pitches down and nose, near eye, and exposed cheek remain aimed screen-right.

135.evidence: Downcast eye and lowered chin combine with an asymmetric right-facing cheek and nose.

157.5.evidence: Downcast eye is clear and the nose and visible cheek still point screen-right; the blue eye and cheek retain a screen-right bias.

180.evidence: Frontal head tips down, both eyes face the bottom edge, and the chin is lowered.

202.5.evidence: Head remains down while nose and near eye start turning to screen-left; hair follows.

225.evidence: Downcast near eye, nose, and cheek clearly occupy the screen-left side of the head.

247.5.evidence: Face approaches left profile with lowered pupil and chin; far cheek recedes.

270.evidence: Unmistakable screen-left profile with nose at the left edge and far eye hidden.

292.5.evidence: Left-facing nose and near eye lift above center while long hair stays attached.

315.evidence: Three-quarter left face has lifted pupils and raised chin, with far cheek partly occluded.

337.5.evidence: Face returns near frontal but pupils and chin still lift with a slight screen-left bias.
